title: Inspect a system without losing the galaxy
description: Four ordinary authenticated players create, join and start one real campaign. The owner reads authorized resources, expands the independent ownership layers and uses the global dock without issuing an unrelated order. Developer entitlement, fixed catalogue/admission clock, the existing construction-prefix command clock and real scheduler HTTP delivery are explicit harness controls, not injected seats or hosted scheduling evidence. The layer journey reserves a real orbital development and recovers that accepted order without resubmitting it.

steps.description: Expand the selected system through its real keyboard control and read separate orbital and surface holdings. Artwork is explicitly illustrative.
steps.acknowledgement: The same selected system expands without changing ownership.
verifications: Authorized fields remain separate, and decorative art is not represented as sensor intelligence.

steps.description: Open the distinct Orbit instrument to inspect entitled fighters, training camps and science stations.
steps.acknowledgement: The orbit instrument expands and exposes an applicable real construction entry.
verifications: Orbital facts are labelled separately from the independent Surface owner.

steps.description: Separately permit normal device motion, close and reopen Orbit by keyboard and measure focused fact separation. Restore reduced motion before captured evidence; this is interaction evidence, not normal-motion visual approval.
steps.acknowledgement: Explicit test control; not a player action or hosted-service certification.

steps.description: Enter construction from Orbit and submit the actual training-camp order, reserving credits only after authoritative acceptance.
steps.acknowledgement: The real construction receipt accepts the order and credits are reserved.
verifications: The authorized balance matches the reviewed quote and exactly one orbital order is listed.

steps.description: Reload, return through Inspect and Orbit, and recover the accepted queue from the real authorized view without sending another build.
steps.acknowledgement: One accepted orbital order and the reserved balance recover after reload.
verifications: Construction still selects the orbital training camp and its recovered queue is readable.

steps.description: Close recovered construction to its Orbit opener, select Surface, then use End in the bounded reading region to read held credits while retaining contextual controls.
steps.acknowledgement: The held credits label is fully inside the bounded reading viewport.
verifications: Keyboard reading does not move the page or replace the selected system.

steps.description: Use the separate Surface instrument to open its actual base construction quote without submitting a second order.
steps.acknowledgement: The actual construction instrument selects a surface Base.
verifications: The prior accepted orbital order remains singular and the reserved balance is unchanged.

steps.description: Collapse the system, open the global command dock and read Economy through the actual authorized projection.
steps.acknowledgement: The actual Empire economy panel opens with keyboard focus.
verifications: The authorized economy provides an enabled return to the galaxy; this check does not certify command absence or peer privacy.

steps.description: Close Economy with Escape and retain the selected system and accessible command opener.
steps.acknowledgement: The dock Economy opener regains focus.
verifications: The same system remains selected after global navigation.

steps.description: Use the factual systems list to select Saiph with the keyboard, then return to the compact inspector.
steps.acknowledgement: The actual selected system is Saiph and the same campaign remains open.
verifications: Credits, last confirmed science and actual next scheduled tick remain readable on phone as well as desktop; the chart and inspector stay within the viewport.

steps.description: Use the actual local setting with normal motion permitted by the device, verify its outcome, then restore the declared reduced-motion capture environment. Selection and authorized resource text remain unchanged.
steps.acknowledgement: The menu closes and restores its opener after acknowledging the local setting.
verifications: Authorized inspector and resource text match exactly; reduced decoration does not alter selected-system facts. This does not certify every canvas marker or hosted timing.
